info.description:
The Wheelhouse Lite API allows users to fetch price recommendations for a listing on demand
without having to create a unit in Wheelhouse or upload any calendar or booking data. The
recommendations will be less specific than from our full Wheelhouse Pro API but can be integrated more
easily and with less development time.

**Note: The API is still in beta testing and maybe subject to changes!**
info.title: Wheelhouse Lite API

get.description: This will fetch recommendations for the listing specified in the parameters.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude in decimal form.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude in decimal form.

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Number of bedrooms in the property.

parameters.name: baths
parameters.description: Number of bathrooms in the property.

parameters.name: sleeps
parameters.description: Number of guests the property can accommodate.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: The ISO-3166 2 letter country code.

parameters.name: num_photos
parameters.description: Number of photos shown on the property's listing.

parameters.name: room_type
parameters.description: Room type of the property. One of `apartment`, `bnb`, `boat`, `bus`, `cabin`, `holiday_home`, `camping`, `camper`, `castle`, `hostel`, `hotel`, `house`, `houseboat`, `island`, `tower`, `mill`, `room`, `shared`.

parameters.name: cleaning_fee
parameters.description: Cleaning fee charged per stay.

parameters.name: security_deposit
parameters.description: Security deposit required per stay.

parameters.name: guests_included
parameters.description: Number of guests included in the base rent.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of amenities. Any of `24_hour_check_in`, `air_conditioning`, `baby_bath`, `baby_monitor`, `babysitter_recommendations`, `balcony`, `bathroom_essentials`, `bathtub`, `bbq`, `beachfront`, `beach_essentials`, `bed_linens`, `bedroom_comforts`, `bicycles`, `breakfast`, `building_staff`, `cable_or_satellite_tv`, `carbon_monoxide_detector`, `ceiling_fans`, `changing_table`, `childrens_books_and_toys`, `childrens_dinnerware`, `cleaning_before_checkout`, `coffee_maker`, `cooking_basics`, `deck`, `dishes_and_silverware`, `dishwasher`, `dryer`, `elevator`, `elderly_accessible`, `essentials`, `ev_charger`, `extra_pillows_and_blankets`, `family_kid_friendly`, `fire_extinguisher` ,`fireplace`, `fireplace_guards`, `first_aid_kit`, `freezer`, `fresh_linens`, `fridge`, `game_console`, `garage`, `gym`, `hair_dryer`, `hangers`, `heating`, `high_chair`, `host_greets_you`, `hot_tub`, `hot_water`, `internet`, `iron`, `jacuzzi`, `kettle`, `keypad`, `kitchen`, `lake_access`, `laptop_friendly_workspace`, `lockbox`, `lock_on_bedroom_door`, `long_term_stays_allowed`, `luggage_dropoff`, `microwave`, `outlet_covers`, `oven`, `parking`, `parking_paid`, `parking_free_street`, `patio`, `pets_allowed`, `pool`, `shared_pool`, `pool_cover`, `pool_toys`, `private_yard`, `private_entrance`, `private_living_room`, `refrigerator`, `room_darkening_shades`, `sauna`, `self_check_in`, `shampoo`, `single_level_home`, `ski_in_out`, `smart_lock`, `smoke_detector`, `smoking_allowed`, `step_free_access`, `stereo`, `stove`, `streaming`, `suitable_for_events`, `table_corner_guards`, `towel`, `travel_crib`, `tv`, `washing_machine`, `waterfront`, `water_views`, `window_guards`.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The ISO-4217 currency code of the currency the results should be in. Defaults to the local market currency.

parameters.name: no_temporality
parameters.description: Turn on/off temporality adjustments for lead-time independent forecasts. Defaults to on.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price limiting recommendation to ensure no recommended price is lower than this value. Defaults to zero.

parameters.name: avg_booking_price
parameters.description: Average nightly price the listing has been booked at in the past. Given in the requested `currency`.

parameters.name: booking_price_certainty
parameters.description: Certainty of the average booking price being a good representation of the listings worth. 0.0 means no certainty at all, 1.0 means full certainty that the price is representative. This can for example be derived from the number of nights booked or from host feedback.

currency.description: The ISO4217 currency code for the recommended prices.

400.description: Parameters malformed, see body for details.

404.description: No market coverage for given location.
